system.subtitle: Tsarin Taimakon Shawarar Lafiya Kan Tarin Fuka
footer.system: TB-CDSS | Tsarin Taimakon Shawarar Lafiya Kan Tarin Fuka
sidebar.note_text: Tallafawa gano tarin fuka da wuri cikin aminci.
home.title: Tsarin Gwajin Tarin Fuka da Tantance Haɗari
home.description: Tsarin yanar gizo na ƙwararru don gwajin tarin fuka na farko, tantance haɗari, bada shawarar gwajin dakin gwaje-gwaje, da tallafin harsuna da dama.
home.card1_text: Yana taimakawa gano masu yiwuwar kamuwa da tarin fuka da wuri.
home.card2_text: Yana bada matakan haɗari, shawarwari, da jagorar gwajin dakin gwaje-gwaje.
home.card3_text: Yana tallafawa Turanci, Yoruba, Hausa, da Igbo don samun sauƙin amfani.
screen.title: Fom Din Gwajin Mara Lafiya Na Tarin Fuka
screen.description: Shigar da bayanan mara lafiya da alamomin rashin lafiya domin tantance haɗari, samar da shawarwari, da bada shawarar gwaje-gwajen dakin gwaje-gwaje.
screen.form.title: Gwajin Mara Lafiya
screen.form.text: Cika fom ɗin da ke ƙasa domin tantance haɗarin TB na farko da samar da shawarwari.
screen.patient_text: Bayanan asali game da mara lafiya.
screen.symptom_text: Zaɓi amsar da ta fi dacewa da alamomin mara lafiya.
screen.q4: Ka rasa nauyi ba tare da dalili ba?
dashboard.title: Bayanin Ma'aikacin Lafiya
dashboard.text: Kula da bayanan gwaji, rarraba haɗari, da sakamakon binciken mara lafiya.
dashboard.total_text: Dukkan bayanan gwajin mara lafiya da aka aika
dashboard.high_text: Marasa lafiya da ke buƙatar bincike cikin gaggawa
dashboard.emergency_text: Marasa lafiya da ke buƙatar tura su asibiti nan take
dashboard.recent_text: Sabbin gwaje-gwajen mara lafiya da aka aika
dashboard.empty_records: Babu bayanan gwajin mara lafiya da aka aika tukuna.
dashboard.access_granted: An ba ka izini na ƙara ma'aikatan lafiya.
dashboard.access_pending: Buƙatar ka na ƙara masu amfani tana jira amincewar admin.
dashboard.access_approved: An amince da buƙatar ka. Yanzu zaka iya ƙara masu amfani.
dashboard.access_rejected: An kashe buƙatar ka. Za ka iya sake aika ta idan ya dace.
dashboard.access_denied: Ba ka da izini na yanzu na ƙara masu amfani. Za ka iya neman izini daga admin.
result.title: Tantance Haɗarin TB Na Mara Lafiya
result.text: Wannan sakamakon na taimakon gwaji na farko ne kawai kuma baya maye gurbin cikakken binciken likita.
result.lab_test: Gwaje-Gwajen Dakin Gwaje-Gwaje Da Aka Bada Shawara
result.next.text: Bi shawarar da ke sama sannan ka tuntubi ƙwararren ma'aikacin lafiya idan ya dace.
recommendation.low: Ci gaba da kiyaye lafiya kuma ka lura da alamomi.
recommendation.moderate: Ziyarci cibiyar lafiya domin gwajin sputum smear microscopy.
recommendation.high: Ana buƙatar bincike cikin gaggawa. A yi gwajin GeneXpert da X-ray na ƙirji.
recommendation.emergency: Ana buƙatar tura mara lafiya cikin gaggawa domin GeneXpert, X-ray na ƙirji, da culture/drug susceptibility testing.
test.low: Ba a bada shawarar gwajin dakin gwaje-gwaje nan take ba. A lura da alamomi kuma a dawo idan sun ci gaba.
test.moderate: Gwajin da aka bada shawara: Sputum smear microscopy.
test.high: Gwaje-gwajen da aka bada shawara: GeneXpert (NAAT) da X-ray na ƙirji.
test.emergency: Gwaje-gwajen gaggawa da aka bada shawara: GeneXpert (NAAT), X-ray na ƙirji, da TB culture/drug susceptibility testing.
login.badge: Wiwọle Ga Ma'aikatan Lafiya Da Aka Amince
login.title: Shigar Ma'aikacin Lafiya
login.text: Shiga da bayanan da aka ba ka domin samun damar bayanan mara lafiya, dashboard, tarihin gwaji, da kayan aikin rahoto.
login.point3: Izini da admin ya amince da shi
login.form_text: Ma'aikatan lafiya da aka ba izini kawai za su iya shiga wannan tsarin.
login.notice_text: Tuntuɓi admin idan ba ka da bayanan shiga.
